evidence_scope: one-time same-source complete-cruise, sparse-place, and recent-time transfer within SOCAT v2026; no cross-dataset claim

figure_captions.fig_sss_01_observed_predicted.png: Figure 1. Held-cruise SSS observations against frozen-candidate predictions. The one-to-one line exposes both the dominant agreement and a small set of strong freshwater failures.
figure_captions.fig_sss_02_cruise_rmse.png: Figure 2. SSS RMSE for every held cruise, ranked on a logarithmic axis. Red bars have modal grade D; the extreme tail explains the gap between pooled and cruise-equal RMSE.
figure_captions.fig_sss_03_grade_coverage.png: Figure 3. SSS 90% interval coverage by frozen applicability grade. The dashed line is the preregistered 0.85 minimum; grade D falls below it and remains suppressed.
figure_captions.fig_sss_04_support_rmse.png: Figure 4. SSS RMSE by distance to the remaining training cruises. Errors increase sharply away from dense support, so distance remains a required product flag.
figure_captions.fig_sss_05_error_map.png: Figure 5. Absolute SSS error at held-cruise grid months. The logarithmic color scale preserves ordinary errors while exposing geographically concentrated freshwater failures.
figure_captions.fig_fco2_01_observed_predicted.png: Figure 6. Held-cruise fCO2 observations against frozen-candidate predictions. Most rows follow the one-to-one line, while a small extreme-estuary tail remains unresolved.
figure_captions.fig_fco2_02_cruise_rmse.png: Figure 7. fCO2 RMSE for every held cruise, ranked on a logarithmic axis. A few complete cruises dominate cruise-equal risk despite acceptable pooled performance.
figure_captions.fig_fco2_03_grade_coverage.png: Figure 8. fCO2 90% interval coverage by frozen applicability grade. A/B meet the pooled gate, while C under-covers and D remains unsuitable for trusted publication.
figure_captions.fig_fco2_04_support_rmse.png: Figure 9. fCO2 RMSE by distance to the remaining training cruises. The 25-100 km bin is especially difficult, and all distant bins retain weak interval coverage.
figure_captions.fig_fco2_05_error_map.png: Figure 10. Absolute fCO2 error at held-cruise grid months. The logarithmic color scale shows that the largest errors are localized rather than uniformly global.
